subject: Insurance
title: India's Third-Party Problem
description: A micro-lesson that makes India's Third-Party Problem usable.

hook.text: India requires only third-party liability insurance. No collision, no comprehensive.

buildup.text: Third-party-only insurance costs as little as $15 a year.

discovery.text: 60% of Indian motor insurance claims are disputed. Fraud, underinsurance, and delayed processing plague the system.

twist.text: India's Supreme Court ordered all vehicles to have at least third-party coverage.

climax.text: India's auto insurance market is growing fast but maturing slowly. Scale exists; enforcement and trust do not.

punchline.text: $15 a year, minimal coverage. India has the vehicles but not the enforcement.

quiz.question: What type of auto insurance is mandatory in India?
